  • NTB opener. Slide 2 uses the host province before the national argument. Drop it if the five NTB speakers before you will have covered the local picture.

Catatan pembicara

Terima kasih. Saya berbicara sebagai Presiden Indonesia SDGs Center Network, jejaring pusat SDGs perguruan tinggi di 34 provinsi. Sebulan lalu di pleno 3 September, ISCN menyampaikan satu tesis: persoalan gizi kita adalah persoalan kemiskinan dan ketimpangan, dan sebagian dari harga pangan yang mahal itu kita ciptakan sendiri lewat kebijakan. Hari ini saya ingin menarik implikasi kebijakannya, dan membaca rumusan sementara ini dengan tiga pertanyaan yang Bappenas minta dari ISCN: apakah ia sistemik, apakah ia terukur, apakah ia berkelanjutan.
▸ Saya mulai dari tuan rumah kita.

Slide 2Pembukaan0:30

NTB has enough food and the fourth-highest stunting: the question is not quantity

A rice-surplus province with the third-lowest undernourishment in Indonesia and 29.8% of its under-fives stunted, up 5.2 points in a year. The national problem in miniature.

2.7%
of NTB's population undernourished in 2025; national 7.9%. Third lowest of 38 provinces.
29.8%
of NTB's children under five stunted in 2024 (SSGI); 24.6% in 2023. Fourth highest of the 36 provinces reported.

Calories are not the constraint here. Diet quality, the first 1,000 days, water and sanitation, and the household budget are. A formulation that opens with production and supply chains answers the wrong question for this province.

Source: author's own chart based on BPS, Prevalensi Ketidakcukupan Konsumsi Pangan by province, 2025 (BPS web API, variable 1473), and Kemenkes, Survei Status Gizi Indonesia 2024, Table 4.3 (severely stunted plus stunted, TB/U). Papua Tengah and Papua Pegunungan are not shown in SSGI 2024 for lack of sample.

Catatan pembicara

Lihat NTB. Provinsi surplus beras, produksi 1,71 juta ton gabah. Prevalensi ketidakcukupan pangan 2,67 persen, ketiga terendah di Indonesia. Tetapi stunting balita 29,8 persen pada SSGI 2024, naik 5,2 poin dari tahun sebelumnya, keempat tertinggi dari 36 provinsi yang dilaporkan. Cukup pangan, kurang gizi. Ini potret nasional kita dalam ukuran kecil: yang kurang bukan beras, melainkan kualitas diet, seribu hari pertama, air dan sanitasi, dan anggaran rumah tangga.
▸ Kalau bukan jumlah pangan, lalu apa? Mari lihat ke mana rumusan ini mengarahkan instrumennya.

Slide 31 · Pendekatan sistem0:50

Direct interventions buy at most a third of the decline; the formulation spends nearly all its instruments there

Indonesia's own stunting strategy sorts every instrument into direct (intervensi spesifik) and indirect (intervensi sensitif) and attributes 30% of the decline to the first and 70% to the second. The rev1 formulation never uses either word.

30 / 70
share of stunting reduction attributed to direct versus indirect interventions in the national stunting strategy (Bappenas and TNP2K, 2018).
≈ 20%
the stunting reduction from scaling the ten proven nutrition-specific interventions to 90% coverage, Lancet 2013.

The formulation's diagnosis is right: availability is not the problem (3,092 kcal a day, a 3 million ton surplus, 4.9 million tons in reserve). But its prescription is almost entirely direct: MBG, SPPG, fortification, food safety. The indirect causes it names, poverty, purchasing power, prices paid by consumers, social protection, sanitation, get one to six mentions, or none.

Chart: author's own count of word stems in 'Bahan Diskusi Sosialisasi Hasil Sementara WNPG XII', rev1, 4 October 2026 (6,168 words), case-insensitive; 'harga' counts every use, most of which concern price stabilisation and procurement. 30/70: Strategi Nasional Percepatan Pencegahan Anak Kerdil 2018–2024 (Bappenas and TNP2K), which defines specific interventions as addressing direct causes and sensitive interventions indirect causes. Lancet: Bhutta et al. (2013), Maternal and Child Nutrition Series, paper 3.

Catatan pembicara

Diagnosis rumusan ini sudah benar: ketersediaan bukan masalah utama; energi tersedia 3.092 kilokalori per kapita per hari, beras surplus 3 juta ton, cadangan hampir 5 juta ton. Kendalanya akses, kualitas diet dan keamanan pangan. Tetapi resepnya tidak mengikuti diagnosisnya. Strategi stunting nasional kita sendiri membagi intervensi menjadi spesifik dan sensitif, langsung dan tidak langsung, dan mengaitkan 30 persen penurunan stunting pada yang pertama, 70 persen pada yang kedua. Lancet 2013 memperkirakan sepuluh intervensi gizi spesifik yang terbukti, pada cakupan 90 persen, hanya menurunkan stunting sekitar seperlima. Rumusan ini tidak memakai kedua kata itu sekali pun. Saya menghitung kata: MBG 35 kali, keamanan pangan 32, SPPG 14, fortifikasi 12. Kemiskinan 4, perlindungan sosial 4, daya beli 6, impor 5, ketimpangan 2, sanitasi nol, cukai dan label nol. Instrumennya langsung; penyebab yang ia sebut sendiri tidak langsung.
▸ Mata rantai pertama yang tidak langsung itu adalah kemiskinan: berapa sebenarnya yang tidak mampu?

Slide 41 · Pendekatan sistem · kemiskinan0:40

Seven in ten Indonesians cannot afford a healthy diet

FAO's July 2026 release puts 68.6% of Indonesians, 196 million people, below the cost of a healthy diet in 2025. The Philippines is at 45%, the world at 33%, Viet Nam at 7%.

68.6%
of Indonesians could not afford a healthy diet in 2025, 195.9 million people (FAO, July 2026).
$5.09
PPP per person per day, the reference cost of a healthy diet in Indonesia, 2025.

On 3 September ISCN cited 43.5% (123 million) from SOFI 2025. FAO re-based the series in July 2026 on the World Bank's 2021 PPP poverty lines, so the levels moved; the ranking and the message did not. This is a poverty number: the binding constraint is the household budget, not the national food balance.

Source: author's own chart based on FAO, FAOSTAT Cost and Affordability of a Healthy Diet (CoAHD), July 2026 release (SOFI 2026); prevalence and number of people unable to afford a healthy diet, 2017–2025; regional and world aggregates as published.

Catatan pembicara

Angka pleno perlu saya perbarui. Pada 3 September kami mengutip 43,5 persen, 123 juta orang, dari SOFI 2025. Pada Juli 2026 FAO memutakhirkan seri ini dengan garis kemiskinan baru Bank Dunia dalam PPP 2021, dan angkanya menjadi 68,6 persen, 196 juta orang, pada 2025. Filipina 45 persen, dunia 33 persen, Vietnam 7 persen. Tingkatnya berubah, pesannya tidak: ini angka kemiskinan. Kendala pengikatnya anggaran rumah tangga, bukan neraca pangan nasional. Rumusan menyebut 'harga diet sehat belum terjangkau penduduk miskin' tanpa angka; angka ini layak menjadi angka pembuka bagian situasi.
▸ Dan di dalam angka rata-rata itu ada ketimpangan.

Slide 51 · Pendekatan sistem · ketimpangan0:40

The poorest fifth carries 2.5 times the stunting and 4 times the hunger of the richest

Stunting is 29.8% in the poorest asset quintile and 12.1% in the richest; undernourishment 12.2% against 2.9%. National averages hide where the problem lives, and so do national targets.

A gradient this steep is a distribution problem before it is a food problem. It is also why targeting matters more than coverage: a programme that reaches 60 million children evenly reaches the poorest fifth no better than the richest. Every indicator in the final formulation should be reported by quintile.

Left: Kemenkes, SSGI 2024, Table 4.4, stunting (severely stunted plus stunted, TB/U) by household economic status, asset quintiles. Right: BPS, Prevalensi Ketidakcukupan Konsumsi Pangan by expenditure quintile, 2024 (BPS web API, variable 2671).

Catatan pembicara

Stunting pada kuintil aset termiskin 29,8 persen, pada kuintil terkaya 12,1 persen: dua setengah kali lipat. Ketidakcukupan pangan 12,2 persen di kuintil termiskin, 2,9 persen di kuintil terkaya: empat kali lipat. Gradien sesteil ini adalah persoalan distribusi sebelum menjadi persoalan pangan. Dan ini sebabnya penargetan lebih penting daripada cakupan: program yang menjangkau 60 juta anak secara merata menjangkau kuintil termiskin tidak lebih baik daripada kuintil terkaya. Setiap indikator dalam rumusan final sebaiknya dilaporkan per kuintil.
▸ Mata rantai tidak langsung yang ketiga adalah harga, terutama beras.

Slide 61 · Pendekatan sistem · harga0:40

Domestic rice costs twice the world price, and policy keeps it there

Affordability is purchasing power divided by food prices. Rice is the largest item in a poor household's basket and in the cost of a healthy diet, and rice policy works on the denominator in the wrong direction.

Rp 16,350
retail rice, traditional markets, September 2026; NTB Rp 13,850. Thai 5% broken export price about Rp 7,465 at Rp 16,000 per dollar.
≈ 40%
the rise in domestic rice prices relative to other prices attributable to import restrictions.

Since January 2023 domestic retail rice has risen 28% while the Thai export price has fallen back to where it stood in 2019–2020; at Rp 16,350 against about Rp 7,500, the domestic price is 2.2 times the world price. That gap is policy, not the market, and the 4.9 million ton reserve is held up by the same policy. It is a transfer from the poorest consumers to large farmers, millers and quota holders.

Source: author's own chart based on PIHPS (Bank Indonesia), retail rice, traditional markets, monthly means, national and NTB, to September 2026; FAO Rice Price Update, Thai 5% broken, FOB Bangkok, converted at Rp 16,000 per USD (indicative, excludes freight and handling). 40% estimate: Development Policy Centre, ANU (see also LPEM FEB UI 2026, CGD).

Catatan pembicara

Keterjangkauan adalah daya beli dibagi harga pangan. Beras eceran September ini 16.350 rupiah per kilogram, di NTB 13.850, sementara harga ekspor Thailand sekitar 7.500 rupiah. Sejak awal 2023 harga beras eceran kita naik 28 persen, sementara harga dunia sudah kembali ke tingkat 2019 sampai 2020; harga domestik hari ini 2,2 kali harga dunia. Pembatasan impor menaikkan harga beras domestik sekitar 40 persen relatif terhadap harga lain. Selisih itu bukan pasar, melainkan kebijakan, dan cadangan hampir 5 juta ton ditopang oleh kebijakan yang sama. Ini transfer dari konsumen termiskin kepada petani besar, penggilingan dan pemegang kuota.
▸ Lalu di mana tempat intervensi langsung, termasuk MBG?

Slide 71 · Pendekatan sistem · intervensi langsung0:35

Direct interventions are necessary, bounded, and need safeguards

The 2026 MBG budget moved from Rp 335 trillion announced to Rp 229 trillion after efficiency, with 57 million recipients reached by August. A programme this large is an institutional market, not an anchor to hang supply contracts on.

Rp 335 T → 229 T
MBG budget for 2026, January announcement versus the post-efficiency figure.
0
mentions of the first 1,000 days in the formulation; the window where direct interventions prevent stunting.

Three safeguards: contingency clauses in any supply contract that small farmers and fishers sign against MBG demand; a separate first-1,000-days track (maternal nutrition, PMT, fortification) from the school-age track, since school meals do not reach the stunting window; and hygiene certification as a precondition for SPPG operation, with incidents reported per million portions.

Source: MBG 2026 budget as announced (Kompas, 19 Jan 2026), BGN ceiling (CNBC Indonesia, Feb 2026), after efficiency with 62.7 million target recipients (Media Indonesia), realisation to 31 August 2026 (Kemenkeu, reported 18 Sept 2026). Food-safety figures from the formulation itself: 560 MBG-related incidents, 1 Jan 2025 to 2 Sept 2026 (Kemenkes).

Catatan pembicara

Intervensi langsung tetap perlu, tetapi terbatas dan perlu pengaman. Anggaran MBG 2026 bergeser dari 335 triliun menjadi 229 triliun dalam satu tahun anggaran; sampai Agustus 57 juta penerima. Program sebesar ini adalah pasar institusional, bukan jangkar untuk menggantungkan kontrak pasok petani dan nelayan kecil; jangkar yang bergeser sepertiga perlu klausul kontingensi. Kedua, pisahkan jalur seribu hari pertama kehidupan, yang tidak disebut sekali pun dalam rumusan, dari jalur anak sekolah: makan siang sekolah tidak menjangkau jendela pencegahan stunting. Ketiga, sertifikat laik higiene sebagai prasyarat SPPG beroperasi, dengan kejadian keracunan dilaporkan per juta porsi.
▸ Pertanyaan kedua: apakah semua ini terukur?

Slide 82 · Indikator terukur0:45

'Measurable' needs a baseline, a target and a year; none of the seven mechanisms has one

The formulation says the strategy must rest on measurable indicators and its closing slide lists candidates. The word 2029 does not appear. The targets already exist: Indonesia's own SDG Roadmap sets stunting at 10% and undernourishment at 3.6% by 2030; the RPJMN adds 14.2% and 4.41% by 2029.

1.6 / 3.3
points a year needed nationally and in NTB to reach the SDG Roadmap's 10% in 2030.
4 names
for one food-and-nutrition data system across the four working groups, plus 'National Logistic Ecosystem', which is a customs platform.

Ask: a results-framework annex binding each mechanism to an indicator with baseline, target and year, reported by quintile and province: stunting, PoU, share of households able to afford a healthy diet, PPH score, inter-provincial price dispersion, poisoning incidents per million MBG portions, share of SPPG certified. One data system with one name and one steward. Monitoring and evidence restored as the eighth mechanism, with independent MBG evaluation and open data; the staged roll-out is a natural experiment.

Chart: Riskesdas 2018, SSGBI 2019, SSGI 2021–2022, SKI 2023 and SSGI 2024 (Kemenkes), national and NTB; dashed lines show the constant annual reduction needed to reach the SDG Roadmap target of 10% in 2030 (Peta Jalan SDGs Indonesia Menuju 2030, Bappenas 2019, intervention scenario; 22.4% under business as usual); the RPJMN 2025–2029 target of 14.2% is marked for reference.

Catatan pembicara

Pertanyaan kedua: apakah rumusan ini terukur. Rumusan menyatakan strategi harus dibangun di atas indikator yang terukur, dan slide penutupnya mencantumkan calon indikator. Tetapi tidak satu pun dari tujuh mekanisme memuat baseline, target, atau tahun; kata 2029 tidak muncul. Padahal targetnya sudah ada, di Peta Jalan SDGs Indonesia sendiri: stunting 10 persen pada 2030, berarti 1,6 poin per tahun secara nasional dan 3,3 poin per tahun untuk NTB; ketidakcukupan pangan 3,6 persen. Usulan konkret: lampiran kerangka hasil yang mengikat setiap mekanisme pada indikator dengan baseline, target dan tahun, dilaporkan per kuintil dan per provinsi. Satu sistem data dengan satu nama dan satu wali data; hari ini empat nama di empat Pokja ditambah National Logistic Ecosystem, yang sebenarnya platform Bea Cukai. Dan kembalikan monev dan bukti saintifik sebagai mekanisme kedelapan, dengan evaluasi independen MBG dan data terbuka; pentahapan wilayah MBG adalah eksperimen alami yang sayang dilewatkan.
▸ Pertanyaan ketiga: apakah ia berkelanjutan dan selaras dengan SDGs?

Slide 93 · Keberlanjutan dan SDGs0:50

The environmental lever is land, not livestock; and provinces already rank zero hunger fourth of 17

Land-use change is about 730 Mt CO₂e a year, paddy methane 35, all livestock 27; the protein that closes the child nutrition gap sits at the low-emission end. A 2025 survey of 27 provincial planning agencies puts zero hunger inside the pillar they rank first; what they lack is data, evidence and capacity.

The formulation's environmental content is one unsourced number (89.5% of farmland 'not yet sustainable') and 'climate-smart agriculture'. The real risk is land expansion for self-sufficiency, so Pokja 1 should say productivity on existing land, not expansion; for MBG the levers are plate waste and packaging, measured per SPPG. On SDG alignment the gap is not commitment but the means to act: ISCN offers the university SDGs Centers in every province as the evidence-and-capacity bridge, to be named in Pokja 4.

Left: land-use change, agriculture-related, 2018 (FAO / FABLE Indonesia); paddy methane (Climate and Clean Air Coalition); livestock is the 2017–2021 annual mean for all species, of which beef cattle 64%. Right: 'SDG Center Business Model' (Asian Development Bank), survey of provincial development planning agencies (Bappeda), fieldwork 25 February to 14 March 2025, 27 of 34 provinces responded; Figure 4-1, mean rank, 1 = highest priority. Both panels as presented on 3 September 2026.

Catatan pembicara

Tema WNPG memuat kata berkelanjutan, tetapi isinya hampir tidak memuat lingkungan: satu angka tanpa sumber dan pertanian cerdas iklim. Angka pleno menunjukkan di mana trade-off sebenarnya berada: alih fungsi lahan sekitar 730 juta ton CO2e per tahun, sawah 35 juta ton, seluruh peternakan 27 juta ton. Protein yang menutup kesenjangan gizi anak, telur, ayam, ikan, dan untuk NTB terutama ikan, ada di ujung rendah emisi. Risiko lingkungan terbesar justru perluasan lahan untuk swasembada; rumusan perlu menegaskan produktivitas di lahan yang ada. Untuk MBG, ungkitnya sisa makanan di piring dan kemasan sekali pakai; ukur per porsi di SPPG. Tentang keselarasan dengan SDGs: survei Bappeda 2025 menunjukkan 27 dari 34 daerah sudah memprioritaskan Tanpa Kelaparan, peringkat keempat dari 17. Yang kurang bukan komitmen, melainkan data, bukti dan kapasitas. Itulah yang ISCN tawarkan: pusat SDGs perguruan tinggi di setiap provinsi sebagai penyambung bukti dan kapasitas daerah, dan kami minta itu disebut dalam Pokja 4.
▸ Izinkan saya menutup dengan implikasi kebijakannya.

Slide 10Penutup · implikasi kebijakan0:45

If malnutrition is poverty and inequality, most of the answer is indirect

Affordable food = purchasing power ÷ food price, for the poorest fifth first. The final formulation needs instruments on both sides of that ratio, a distribution lens on every target, and direct interventions where they bind.

↑ Raise purchasing power

  • Social protection judged by how much of the poorest quintile it reaches, not by headcount; the quintile where stunting is 29.8% and hunger 12.2%.
  • Quality jobs: growth reaches the household budget as wages or not at all.
  • Pokja 2: an affordability-of-healthy-diet target by quintile.

↓ Lower the real price of food

  • Productivity on existing land, not expansion (Pokja 1).
  • Stop raising prices by policy: test every trade restriction and stock decision against the cost of a healthy diet (Pokja 2).
  • Demand-side fiscal instruments, excise, labelling, marketing limits, in Pokja 3.

≡ Put distribution in every target

  • Stunting, PoU, affordability and PPH reported by quintile and province, with baseline, target and year.
  • One data system, one name, one steward.
  • Monitoring and independent evaluation as the eighth mechanism.

● Direct where it binds

  • The first 1,000 days as its own track: maternal nutrition, PMT, fortification.
  • MBG as one institutional market: contingency clauses, safety certification first, incidents per million portions.
  • Universities and SDGs Centers named in Pokja 4 as the provinces' evidence-and-capacity bridge.

Food security is not the same as self-sufficiency, and protecting children's protein is not an environmental cost.

Framework as on the speaker's 3 September 2026 deck, slide 15 (affordable food = purchasing power ÷ food price); quintile figures from slides 5 and 8.

Catatan pembicara

Kalau persoalan gizi kita adalah kemiskinan dan ketimpangan, maka sebagian besar jawabannya tidak langsung. Pangan terjangkau adalah daya beli dibagi harga pangan, dan ukurannya kuintil termiskin, bukan rata-rata. Naikkan daya beli: perlindungan sosial yang dinilai dari seberapa banyak kuintil termiskin yang dijangkau, bukan dari jumlah penerima; lapangan kerja bermutu. Turunkan harga riil pangan: produktivitas di lahan yang ada; berhenti menaikkan harga lewat kebijakan, uji setiap pembatasan impor dan keputusan stok terhadap biaya diet sehat; instrumen fiskal sisi permintaan di Pokja 3. Masukkan distribusi ke setiap target: stunting, ketidakcukupan pangan, keterjangkauan dan PPH per kuintil dan per provinsi, dengan baseline, target dan tahun. Dan intervensi langsung di tempat ia mengikat: seribu hari pertama sebagai jalur sendiri, MBG sebagai salah satu pasar institusional dengan klausul kontingensi dan sertifikasi keamanan lebih dulu. Dua kalimat dari pleno layak masuk apa adanya: ketahanan pangan tidak sama dengan swasembada, dan melindungi protein untuk anak-anak kita bukan beban bagi lingkungan. Terima kasih.
